title: Oppenheimer recalls the Trinity test and the Bhagavad Gita
summary: Robert Oppenheimer tells of Oppenheimer recalls the Trinity test and the Bhagavad Gita, about 1945 at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I remembered the line from the Hindu scripture, the Bhagavad Gita. Now I am become death, the destroyer of worlds.

plain: Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the American effort to build the atomic bomb, is heard in an episode of Jesse Michels's podcast remembering Trinity, the first atomic bomb test, in New Mexico in 1945. He recalls that on seeing the blast he thought of a line from the Bhagavad Gita, a Hindu scripture: "Now I am become death, the destroyer of worlds." The episode uses his words to mark the start of the nuclear age.
